name: Ciel and Flipboard
description: Fox Ciel has a board with n rows and n columns, there is one integer in each cell. It's known that n is an odd number, so let's introduce . Fox Ciel can do the following operation many times: she choose a sub-board with size x rows and x columns, then all numbers in it will be multiplied by -1. Return the maximal sum of numbers in the board that she can get by these operations.
input_specification: The first line contains an integer n , ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 33 , and n is an odd integer) — the size of the board. Each of the next n lines contains n integers — the numbers in the board. Each number doesn't exceed 1000 by its absolute value.
output_specification: Output a single integer: the maximal sum of numbers in the board that can be accomplished.
approach_summary: Apply Knapsack and Basic Dynamic Programming paradigm under the Dynamic Programming (DP) framework. Exploit problem invariants to reduce state space and achieve optimal complexity.
